'''Strayit''' was an individual who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], eventually earning the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] on board the vessel ''[[Marshall Awe]]''. Whilst Strayit was captain, [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]] served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on board the vessel and during a [[Poporov merchant rebellion|rebellion]] by the [[Poporov merchants]] of [[Armstiss]], the lieutenant saved the captain's life. Strom took a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt intended for Strayit and then, ignoring the pain, grabbed the [[Poporov merchant leader|leader]] of the rebellious [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and pushed a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into his pants before throwing him off a cliff into a crowd of his followers. The subsequent explosion killed the vast majority of rebels along with most of their merchant stalls, with those left alive to afraid to rebel again. For his heroics, Strom was promoted to the position of [[Executive officer/Legends|First officer]] on board the starship ''[[Peacehawk]]''.<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Strayit was first mentioned in the second part of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', an article released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]. The article does not establish Strayit's [[Species/Legends|species]] or [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and also does not make clear if the events involving him take place in the [[Rebellion era]] or the [[Rise of the Empire era]].
